Our group looks into whether a government, an agency or a public body keeps its own rules and promises. We check what it says against its own records, and publish what the records show.

Each finding we publish points to the passage it rests on: a page of a budget, a line of the minutes, a row of an office's own data. Open any finding in a published case and the passage opens with it, so you can read it yourself.

Each piece of evidence carries a letter, A strongest to D weakest, and says why it has that letter: a copy fetched from the office's own website holds up better than one found elsewhere. A finding is never stronger than its weakest piece, and where something isn't known, the case says so instead of guessing.
